Raisin Oatmeal Cookies With Nuts
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 (18.5 oz.) cake mix
1 lg. egg
1/4 c. vegetable oil
1 c. of either chopped nuts, raisins, 
Preparation

1 Good with mint flavored chocolate chips. 2 Stir all ingredients. Drop teaspoons on a cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350 degrees.
